name: Probabilistic Silhouette Search
definition: A search heuristic that initially finds a silhouette edge and then uses spatial coherence to rapidly trace out an entire silhouette outline using adjacency information.
summary: Probabilistic Silhouette Search is a spatial coherence-based heuristic that rapidly traces silhouette edges on polygonal meshes by prioritizing sharp dihedral angles, offering significant speedups over brute-force methods.
